source_ref.product: 토스증권 주식투자 앱 (Toss Securities stock-trading app)
source_ref.production_note: Fast-cut 41.8s securities spot built as a surreal world-hopping montage intercut with real app-UI inserts. Conceptual VO/kinetic-typo build equates investing with everyday consumer apps: 음악 듣듯 (like listening to music) / 영화 고르듯 (like choosing a movie) / 쇼핑하듯 (like shopping) → 난 주식해 (I do stocks). Distinct colour-coded dream worlds: cool-blue mirror-floor void with floating app cards and streetlamps; saturated red sofa void with floating company-logo discs; warm amber and orange portrait beats; violet search-bar world (라면 typed); bright white giant-app-card floor payoff. App-UI inserts show the Toss Securities home ranking tiles (영업이익률 TOP50 / 거래량 TOP100 / 시가총액 TOP100 / 관심 TOP100 / 구매 TOP100 / 수익률 TOP100; nav 홈·내 소비·혜택·주식·전체), a company-pick onboarding screen (관심있는 회사를 선택해주세요 / 맞춤 정보를 알려드려요), a stock chart (최저 152,955; 1일·1주일·1개월·3개월·1년·5년) and a one-share buy sheet (1주를 구매할게요 / 245,000 원). Persistent Korean investment disclaimer strip across the back half. Closing emotional CU of a denim-clad woman: 이 주식, 처음인데 익숙하다. End-card: 토스증권 speech-bubble logo on sky-blue.

target_demo: Korean adults 20s–30s, mobile-native first-time and casual retail investors who already live in consumer apps (music, streaming, shopping)
narrative_arc: surreal_wide_open → conceptual_card_worlds_with_kinetic_typo → app_ui_truth_inserts → world_hops_music_movie_shopping → decision_buy_screen → bright_payoff_world → character_callback_montage → emotional_close → brand_logo

production_signature.signature_note: Each conceptual beat lives in its own seamless colour-graded infinity studio (blue mirror-floor, red sofa void, amber/orange portrait, violet search world, white giant-card floor). Translucent holographic app cards and floating logo discs orbit the subject; glassy floors double the composition in reflection; real phone-screen macro inserts cut in for product truth. White rounded Korean kinetic typography builds the music/movie/shopping/주식 line. Persistent disclaimer strip pinned to the lower edge across the back half.
